description: Header file defining the 'Library' class in the Thunder::Core namespace, including methods for dynamic library handling, iteration over loaded modules, and related data structures.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: Represents a dynamically loaded library with methods for loading functions, checking load status, and managing references.

classes.name: Library::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating loaded modules or libraries depending on platform.

methods.name: Library(const void* functionInLibrary)
methods.description: Constructs a Library object from a function pointer within a library.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructs a Library object from a filename.

methods.name: IsLoaded()
methods.description: Checks if the library is loaded.

methods.name: WaitUnloaded()
methods.description: Waits for the library to unload with an optional timeout.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the name of the library.

methods.name: LoadFunction()
methods.description: Loads a function from the library by name.

methods.name: AddRef()
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the library.

methods.name: Release()
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and unloads if zero.
